en.title: Southwest crew dispute delays flight over two hours; attendant reportedly quits
en.summary: Two Southwest Airlines flight attendants argued in front of a fully boarded aircraft, delaying flight 557 by two hours and 24 minutes; one of the attendants has reportedly since quit.
body: Southwest Airlines flight 557 was scheduled to operate from Dallas Love Field (DAL) to Kansas City International Airport (MCI) on Friday, November 6, using a Boeing 737-700 registered N255WN. An eyewitness passenger posting on Reddit described two flight attendants arguing at the front of the aircraft in full view of the passengers on board; the crew were then taken off the aircraft, and passengers were told that a flight attendant was sick, before the captain explained over the loudspeaker that the two had “personality differences”. According to a report by View From The Wing, one of the flight attendants involved has since quit after being embarrassed by the verbal argument in front of a fully boarded aircraft.

The flight was scheduled to depart at 2:25 PM. Due to an initial maintenance delay and then the crew argument, it was delayed two hours and 24 minutes before finally pushing back and departing for Kansas City. The one-hour, four-minute flight landed in Kansas City at 6:16 PM, two hours and 21 minutes behind its scheduled arrival time of 3:55 PM. With the crew member reportedly quitting and refusing to operate the flight, Southwest had to find a replacement crew member, which was the primary cause of the delay. A 737-700 is typically crewed by two pilots and three cabin crew for 137 passengers in an all-economy configuration, and Southwest is the largest operator of the 737-700, with more than 270 active aircraft in its fleet.

Simple Flying reached out to Southwest for comment on Saturday, but an airline spokesperson could not immediately be reached. Flight 557 is a regular scheduled six-weekly service between Dallas and Kansas City; the aircraft operating it was a Boeing 737-7H4, serial number 32513, delivered on September 19, 2006, and 20.2 years old.

zh.title: 西南航空組員機上爭執致班機延誤逾兩小時，一人傳已辭職
zh.summary: 西南航空557號班機兩名組員在已登機的客機上發生口角，班機延誤2小時24分；據報導，其中一名組員事後已辭職。
body: 西南航空557號班機原定11月6日星期五由達拉斯愛田飛往堪薩斯城，機型為波音737-700（註冊編號N255WN）。據目擊乘客在Reddit分享，兩名組員在客機前部、眾多乘客面前發生口角；組員隨後被帶下飛機，乘客被告知一名組員身體不適，機長其後透過廣播解釋，稱兩人是「個性不合」。據View From The Wing報導，其中一名組員在眾目睽睽下與同事爭吵、深感難堪後已辭職。
班機表定下午2時25分起飛，因初期維修延誤加上組員爭執，最終延誤2小時24分才起飛；航程1小時4分，於傍晚6時16分抵達堪薩斯城，較表定下午3時55分晚2小時21分。由於傳出組員辭職且拒絕執飛，西南航空須另找替代組員才能放行班機，成為延誤主因。737-700通常配置兩名機師與三名客艙組員，可載137名全經濟艙乘客；西南航空是737-700最大營運商，現役逾270架。
Simple Flying於星期六聯繫西南航空置評，但未能即時聯繫上發言人。557號班機為達拉斯至堪薩斯城每週六班的定期航班；執飛航機為波音737-7H4，機齡20.2年，2006年9月19日交付。
